_comment: ProjectMan status bridge for Grok Build (xAI 'grok'). Installed into ~/.grok/hooks/ by install.sh or the Settings -> Agents button (both share the same install machinery, which also flips [compat.claude] hooks=false so claude's hook.js does NOT double-fire on grok events). The command paths below are rewritten AT INSTALL TIME to the absolute installed script path (F12b) — this repo copy keeps the portable ~ form; the installed copy never relies on grok shell-expanding '~'. JSON hook KEYS are PascalCase (probe finding: the hook DEFINITION uses PascalCase; the env var GROK_HOOK_EVENT and the stdin payload's hookEventName are snake_case). The status script keys its state machine off the snake_case wire names. SessionStart/UserPromptSubmit/Stop drive the dots; PreToolUse phase-stamps for the watcher-side waiting inference (F11); PostToolUse/PostToolUseFailure/PermissionDenied clear the phase; Notification is registered but ignored by the script (internal hook receipt).
